resources.string: How to set up a server
1. Tap Add server, choose an installed model and optionally give it a name. Save keeps the server for later.
2. Tap Start and open Chat to use it immediately. You can also start, stop or open Chat from its card. Easy servers stop after 10 idle minutes.
3. Open Server arguments on a card to add llama.cpp flags. Advanced setup can reuse a saved profile. LLM Settings has the full controls for context, threads and other model options.
Optional llama.cpp flags go here. The app already supplies the executable, model and port. Leave this empty to use the profile defaults.
Example: --no-warmup. Separate flags with spaces and quote paths containing spaces.
Close all quotes before saving the arguments.
Leave the template empty to generate the command automatically. For a custom template, start with {default_args} to retain the saved model settings.
Changes apply after stopping and starting the server. Other cards using this saved profile receive the same changes. Easy servers keep their local connection and automatic idle stop.
Install a chat model first. Choose a GGUF model in LLM models, then return to Chat now.
Choose a model and start chatting. The app takes care of setup.
Only installed LLM and vision GGUF models are shown.
Install an LLM or vision GGUF model from the model library, then try again.
Could not save the managed server.
Choose an installed model first. The app creates one managed server and keeps it linked to that model.
